sir_rogers.name: SIR ROGERS
sir_rogers.tone: Cheeky, analytical, fast-paced, game theory exploits, conversational hustle psychology
sir_rogers.hook_formula: Second-person POV simulation, roleplay job assignment, or absurdity question ('You're a casino owner and you have a problem...', 'Your job is to design...', 'You just bet $10 on red...')
narrative_structure: 1. POV Roleplay / Simulation Hook ('You're a [role] and you have a problem. Here's how you fix it.')
2. The First Exploit / Tactical Move ('Take down all the clocks, block out the windows...')
3. The Psychological Mechanism / Sensory Bias ('Now their sense of time blurs. But this is worthless unless you replace cash with chips...')
4. The Escalation Trap ('And just when they want to quit, stop them right there and hand them a VIP card...')
5. The Cynical Witty Wrap-up / Cliffhanger ('Congrats. You just designed the most profitable casino game in history.')
